name: Ame
source:
Class: - (Caretaker of Paradise)
Likes: Seeing people smile
Dislikes: Has none

Ame is a girl-type AI who greeted the protagonist upon his arrival on Kazana Island. She proclaims that it is her role to make everyone on the island happy. Her perpetual smile makes her the pride and joy of the island residents.

Apart from her usual duties, she is also in charge of maintenance of the entire system governing the island.

"I exist to make everyone happy♪"
